name: MRCR
intro: OpenAI MRCR（多轮共指消解）通过合成长多轮写作对话，测试模型能否从同分布干扰项中按顺序找回第 i 个目标回答。数据覆盖2、4、8个针和八个4K至1M词元长度桶，每个组合100条，共2,400条；回答须先输出指定随机前缀，再以 Python SequenceMatcher 与标准文本计算相似度。
build_method: 合成长对话, GPT-4o生成回答
task_type: 开放式问答, 多轮对话
eval_feature: 2/4/8个针, 八个长度桶, 前缀门控
eval_feature_en: 2/4/8 needles, eight length bins, prefix gate
intro_en: OpenAI MRCR (Multi-round Coreference Resolution) uses synthetic long multi-turn writing conversations to test whether a model can retrieve the i-th target response among same-distribution distractors. It covers 2, 4, and 8 needles across eight 4K-to-1M-token bins with 100 samples per combination, for 2,400 total; the response must start with a required random prefix before Python SequenceMatcher compares it with the gold text.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[定义基准目标] --> B[设计任务: 多轮对话与隐藏“针”]
    B --> C[确定“针”的数量: 2, 4, 8] 
    C --> D[选择写作主题与格式: 438实体, 10格式]
    D --> E[使用GPT-4o生成对话内容] 
    E --> F{“针”与干扰项分布一致性检查}
    F -- 是 --> G[生成多轮对话样本]
    F -- 否 --> E
    G --> H[嵌入“针”到对话中]
    H --> I[生成模型指令: 返回第i个“针”]
    I --> J[数据集初步生成]
    J --> K{Quality Control: 检查“针”数量与真实性}
    K -- 发现错误 --> L[错误数据点修正与更新]
    L --> J
    K -- 无错误 --> M[根据Token数量分桶: 8个区间]
    M --> N[每桶100个样本]
    N --> O[Final Dataset组成]
    O --> P[Evaluation方法: 模型预置字母数字哈希]
    P --> Q[Evaluation方法: SequenceMatcher相似度计算]
    Q --> R[Evaluation方法: 哈希不匹配则相似度为0]
    R --> S[发布数据集]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the current official openai/mrcr dataset card and grading code. The diagram preserves 438 entities, ten formats, GPT-4o-generated responses for needles and distractors, same-distribution multi-turn construction, 2/4/8 identical asks, one-indexed target retrieval, the required random prefix, eight exact prompt-plus-answer length bins from 4,096 to 1,048,576 tokens, 100 samples per bin and 2,400 total, corrected-release maintenance, prefix-zero gate, prefix stripping, and difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio scoring.
